containerRegistries.help: The registries a code source's built image can be pushed to, for running it on a remote host. Each field can hold a value or a secret reference such as ${secret:registry_token}. With no registry, a built image is downloaded instead.
containerRegistries.none: No container registries. Built images can still be downloaded.
containerRegistries.addressHelp: The registry, with its port where it has one, and the repository namespace images are pushed under, for example ghcr.io/example or registry.example.com:5000/data.
containerRegistries.credentialHelp: The password or access token the user name signs in with, for example a GitHub personal access token with write:packages.
containerRegistries.caBundleHelp: Only for a registry whose certificate is signed by your own authority: its PEM certificate, or a secret reference. It is trusted beside the public authorities. Leave empty otherwise.
containerRegistries.defaultHelp: A build pushes here unless it names another registry. An organization has one default registry.
